description: Set environment variables (API keys, feature flags, service URLs) for a project in one atomic change. Values are encrypted at rest; with secret: true they are write-only and redacted from logs. Changes take effect on the next deploy, or immediately with apply: true (the live release restarts safely; the tool waits until the new release serves). If applying fails, the error says `envSaved: true`: the change is saved and the previous release keeps serving. On failure, follow error.details.retry: idempotencyKey "reuse" means the outcome is unknown, so call again with the same idempotencyKey (it resumes or replays the original request instead of starting a second release); "new" means the release already failed, so call again without idempotencyKey or with a new one (the old key only replays that failure); waitFirst means call project_status until no operation is running before retrying. For values that live in a local dotenv file (.env, .env.local, ...), call import_env with its path instead so the values never pass through this conversation; never echo secret values back to the user. Public values a framework inlines at build time (NEXT_PUBLIC_*, VITE_*, PUBLIC_*, EXPO_PUBLIC_*, REACT_APP_*) need build: true, an `ARG NAME` line in the Dockerfile stage that runs the build, and then deploy_project to rebuild; build variables are never secret and cannot be applied without a rebuild.

apply.description: Serve the new environment now by restarting the live release. Default: next deploy.

build.description: Build variables: also pass every value to the image build as --build-arg (public values only, never secret; redeploy to use them). Default false keeps an existing variable's flag.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse this exact value when retrying. Generated when omitted.

secret.description: Store every value in this call as a write-only secret. Default false keeps an existing variable's flag.

vars.description: NAME -> value. Upper-case names; PORT, RIGHTSIDE_* and POLIGON_* are reserved. DATABASE_URL may hold an external database URL unless the project has a RightSide database.

name: set_env
